name: Niloufer Cafe
quote: We run all day, every day, and we cannot close for repairs. The lift has kept working through that, and when we have called, someone has answered.

name: Lekha Nilayam
quote: We wanted the lift to sit in the middle of the house without closing it in. Zion designed the shaft around the light rather than the other way round.

name: Owaisi Hospitals
quote: Our lifts move beds, not just people. Levelling and door width were the specifications we cared about, and those are the ones that were got right.

name: Kashi Yadhav
quote: The house was finished and we were living in it. They built the whole shaft in the stairwell without cutting a single slab.

name: Chath Restaurant
quote: The rooftop only works as a dining floor because guests can reach it in seconds. The lift made that terrace commercially viable.
